import openpyxl
import os
import re

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/32255/1_32255_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/32255_0_7977b830/1_32255_output.xlsx"

# 1. INSPECT
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb.active

print("Workbook sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
print("Active sheet:", ws.title)
print("Dimensions:", ws.max_row, ws.max_column)

print("Used values/formulas in A:D:")
for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    row_vals = [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(1, min(ws.max_column, 4) + 1)]
    print(r, row_vals)

print("Formulas found:")
for row in ws.iter_rows():
    for cell in row:
        if isinstance(cell.value, str) and cell.value.startswith("="):
            print(cell.coordinate, cell.value)

# 2. SOLVE
# Modify only D2:D13. Preserve the existing formula logic in D, but wrap it so blank A cells return blank.
for r in range(2, 14):
    cell = ws[f"D{r}"]
    a_ref = f"A{r}"
    original = cell.value

    if isinstance(original, str) and original.startswith("="):
        compact = re.sub(r"\s+", "", original.upper())

        already_handles_blank = (
            compact.startswith(f'=IF({a_ref.upper()}=""')
            or compact.startswith(f'=IF(ISBLANK({a_ref.upper()})')
        )

        if not already_handles_blank:
            cell.value = f'=IF({a_ref}="","",{original[1:]})'
    else:
        # If the cell is not a formula, only clear it when the corresponding A cell is blank.
        # This keeps changes restricted to the requested blank-cell behavior.
        if ws[a_ref].value in (None, ""):
            cell.value = None

# Encourage recalculation when opened/evaluated
try:
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
except Exception:
    pass

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# 3. VERIFY
verify_wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
verify_ws = verify_wb.active

print("Final D2:D13 formulas/values:")
final_values = []
for r in range(2, 14):
    v = verify_ws[f"D{r}"].value
    final_values.append(v)
    print(f"D{r}: {v}")

print("Manual verification of blank handling:")
input_wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
input_ws = input_wb.active

for r in range(2, 14):
    a_val = input_ws[f"A{r}"].value
    d_val = verify_ws[f"D{r}"].value

    if a_val in (None, ""):
        ok = d_val is None or (isinstance(d_val, str) and f'A{r}=""' in d_val)
        print(f"Row {r}: A is blank, D will return blank -> {ok}")
    else:
        old_d = input_ws[f"D{r}"].value
        if isinstance(old_d, str) and old_d.startswith("="):
            ok = isinstance(d_val, str) and old_d[1:] in d_val
        else:
            ok = d_val == old_d
        print(f"Row {r}: A has data, original D logic/value preserved -> {ok}")
